name: duplicate-delivery
title: Payments counted twice in the books
label: Captured from Klaxon's synthetic payments system, live on Docker Compose on this Mac: synthetic data only, no real customers or money. Klaxon's own fault runner injected the fault under synthetic traffic, and Klaxon's own alert rules raised the alert from what the stack showed. At that moment, with the fault in place, this script called Klaxon's own read-only tools in place of a model: money_check and recent_deploys, as their results came back, and every log line Loki held for the four services. No model was called.

fault.name: duplicate-delivery
fault.title: Payments counted twice in the books
fault.cause: a deploy of the ledger consumer without its dedupe (LEDGER_HANDLER=naive): every webhook the provider sends again, after an acknowledgement it never got, is booked a second time
expected_symptoms: the money check fails: events counted twice, the books ahead of the provider by their amounts
the webhook dashboard stays green, and consumer lag stays at 0
the ledger stops reporting 'already processed' while the confirmer still sees the same duplicates
fault.remedy: roll the ledger consumer back to the idempotent handler, then repair each double posting with a reversal (a write, so it needs approval)

alert.name: MoneyCheckFailed
alert.summary: The money check failed 2 of its 5 invariants: posted_exactly_once (5 findings), matches_provider (6 findings). By its count, our ledger is $116.97 ahead of the provider's balance.

captured.command_paths: paths shown relative to this repo, and a temporary folder as <tmp>
